introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.text: StableFit respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and share information about you when you use our Coach and Client mobile applications and website.
introduction.controller: Data controller: Ihor Savva, operating as SavvaDev - Ihor Savva, a sole proprietorship registered in Poland. Contact: support@stable-fit.com. Registered office: Poland, woj. MAZOWIECKIE, pow. Warszawa, gm. Warszawa, miejsc. Warszawa, ul. Bobrowiecka, nr 10, lok. 67, 00-728. Tax identification number (NIP): 5214103415.

items.item1: StableFit is the controller of your account, authentication, device and usage data, push tokens, analytics and crash data, and Coach subscription status (billing records we store on our servers).
items.item2: Your Coach is an independent controller of personal data they process in the course of coaching (training plans, notes, surveys they send, and the progress data they view). We process that content to provide the platform.
items.item3: By accepting a Coach invitation, a Client understands that the assigned Coach can see the Client's progress data and photos in the Service. Coaches cannot delete Clients; a Client who wants data removed should contact us (and may also ask their Coach to stop using the data in their own records).

info.title: 3. Information We Collect

items.account: Account data: name, email address, role (Coach or Client), authentication identifiers. You may sign in with Apple or Google; those providers share the identifiers you authorize.
items.health: Health and fitness data (special category): if you choose to provide it — body measurements (for example weight and circumferences), progress photos, workout logs, nutrition and water logs, and survey answers about training or diet. Processing this data requires your explicit consent. Some features will not work if you do not provide it.
items.communications: Communications: in-app chat and similar messages between Coach and Client.
items.device: Device and usage data: app logs, device type, OS version, performance data, crash reports, and approximate diagnostics needed to run the Service.
items.push: Push notifications: a device push token (Apple Push Notification service or Firebase Cloud Messaging) if you allow notifications.
items.analytics: Analytics: events about how you use the app, collected via Google Firebase (Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance, Remote Config) and PostHog (product analytics).
items.subscription: Subscription data (Coaches): product identifier, store (App Store or Google Play), billing period, transaction identifiers, subscription status, and related timestamps. This status is stored on your StableFit account so Pro access follows the account, not a single device. We do not receive your full payment card number. Apple and Google process the payment.

info.noSell: We do not sell your personal data or photos to third parties, and we do not use progress photos for advertising.

items.contract: Contract (Art. 6(1)(b)): creating and operating your account, providing the Service, storing Coach subscription status, customer support.
items.consent: Consent (Art. 6(1)(a) and, for health data, Art. 9(2)(a)): health and fitness data, progress photos, optional push notifications. You may withdraw consent at any time (for example by deleting photos or measurements, disabling notifications, or requesting account deletion). Withdrawal does not affect processing already carried out.
items.legitimate: Legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f)): security, fraud prevention, fixing bugs, and understanding product usage (Firebase and PostHog) in a way that is proportionate and not overridden by your interests.
items.obligation: Legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)): where we must keep limited billing or accounting records or respond to lawful requests.

items.item1: To provide and maintain the Service, including matching a Client with their assigned Coach.
items.item2: To allow Coaches to view Client progress after the Client is assigned.
items.item3: To apply Coach plan limits (free plan up to three Clients; Pro via in-app subscription) and keep subscription status on the Coach account across devices.
items.item4: To send transactional and (if enabled) push notifications.
items.item5: To monitor usage, diagnose crashes, and improve the Service.

sharing.title: 6. Sharing and Processors
sharing.lead: We share data only as needed to run the Service:

items.coach: With your Coach: the assigned Coach can access your progress data and photos in the app. Our app does not provide a dedicated "Download" button, but a Coach using a web browser may still save images with standard browser functions.
items.supabase: Supabase — database, authentication, and file storage. Data location: EU (North).
items.firebase: Google Firebase (Google Ireland Limited / Google LLC) — Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance, Remote Config, Cloud Messaging.
items.revenuecat: RevenueCat — subscription status and App Store / Google Play receipt validation. Apple and Google process the purchase itself.
items.appleGoogle: Apple / Google — Sign in with Apple, Google Sign-In, push delivery, and in-app purchases where you use those services.
items.cloudflare: Cloudflare — hosting and security for this website.
items.legal: Legal requirements: we may disclose data if required by Polish or other applicable law or valid public-authority requests.

transfers.title: 7. International Transfers
transfers.text: Some processors (including Google, PostHog, RevenueCat, and Apple) may process data outside the European Economic Area, including in the United States. Where we do so, we rely on an adequacy decision (including the EU-US Data Privacy Framework where a processor is certified) and/or Standard Contractual Clauses, plus supplementary measures where appropriate.

storage.title: 8. Data Storage and Security
storage.text: Account and content data (including photos) are stored using Supabase. Access to photos is limited to the authorized Client and their assigned Coach, plus our processors as needed to operate storage. No method of transmission or storage is 100% secure; we use commercially reasonable technical and organizational measures.

retention.title: 9. Retention
retention.text: We keep personal data while your account is active and as needed for the purposes in this Policy. After we process an account deletion request, we remove data from our active databases. Limited copies may remain in backups for a short period until those backups rotate. Subscription and transaction identifiers may be kept for as long as Apple, Google, or applicable accounting rules require. If a Coach is in read-only mode for plan limits, we do not delete Client data for that reason alone.

rights.title: 10. Your Rights
rights.lead: If the GDPR/RODO applies (including if you are in the EEA), you may:

items.access: Access a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
items.erase: Erase your account and associated data (photos, measurements, and other content we store), subject to legal retention.
items.restrict: Restrict or object to certain processing, and request portability of data you provided.
items.withdraw: Withdraw consent for health data and photos by deleting them or not uploading new ones, and for notifications in device settings.

rights.exercise: To exercise these rights, email support@stable-fit.com. We will respond without undue delay and in any event within one month (extendable by two months for complex requests, with notice). Cancelling a Pro subscription in Apple or Google does not by itself delete your StableFit account.

children.title: 11. Children
children.text: The Service is for users 18 years or older. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe we have, contact us and we will delete it.

changes.title: 12. Changes
changes.text: We may update this Privacy Policy. We will change the "Last Updated" date and, where the change is material, provide additional notice in the app or by email.

contact.title: 13. Contact
contact.terms: Use of the Service is also governed by our Terms of Use.

introduction.text2: By accessing or using the Service, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you disagree with any part of these Terms, you may not access the Service. If you use the Service as a Coach, you do so for your professional coaching activity.

age.title: 2. Age Restriction
age.text: The Service is intended solely for users who are 18 years of age or older. By accessing or using the Service, you represent and warrant that you are at least 18 years old. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under the age of 18.

description.title: 3. Description of Service
description.text: StableFit is a platform that facilitates communication and progress tracking between fitness coaches ("Coaches") and their clients ("Clients"). The Service includes a Coach application and a Client application.

items.tool: We are a Tool Provider: StableFit provides the software infrastructure. We do not provide fitness advice, medical diagnosis, or employ the Coaches using our platform.
items.verification: No Coach Verification: We do not verify the credentials, diplomas, or certifications of Coaches. Clients are solely responsible for vetting their Coaches before engaging in any training program.
items.clientAccess: Client access: Client registration is available only via a personal invitation from a Coach. Clients do not pay StableFit for the Service.

medical.title: 4. Medical Disclaimer
medical.text: StableFit is not a medical application. The content, charts, and data within the Service are for informational purposes only.

items.item1: You should consult your physician or other health care practitioner before starting any exercise or nutrition program.
items.item2: StableFit is not responsible for any health problems, injuries, or damages that may result from training programs provided by Coaches or your use of the Service.

items.item1: You must provide accurate information and keep your login credentials confidential. You are responsible for activity under your account.
items.item2: Coaches may invite Clients. Coaches cannot delete Clients from the Service. If you need an account removed, the account holder may request deletion as described below.
items.item3: To delete your own account, email support@stable-fit.com. Deletion of a Coach account does not automatically cancel an App Store or Google Play subscription; you must cancel that subscription in the store as described in Section 6.

subscriptions.title: 6. Coach Subscriptions and Payments
subscriptions.lead: This Section applies to Coaches. Clients are not charged by StableFit.
subscriptions.plansTitle: 6.1 Plans. Coaches may use the Service under a free plan or a paid "Pro" subscription.

items.free: Free plan: A Coach may use the Service with full write access for up to three (3) Clients.
items.pro: Pro: Auto-renewable monthly or yearly subscription. The title of the subscription, length of the subscription period, and price are displayed in the Coach application at the time of purchase and may vary by country and store. We do not offer a free trial.
items.readonly: If a Coach has more than three Clients and does not have an active Pro subscription (including after expiry or cancellation at the end of a paid period), the Coach's access becomes read-only: the Coach may view existing data but may not add Clients, workouts, measurements, or other write actions we designate in the app. Existing Clients and their data are not deleted because of this limit. Because Coaches cannot delete Clients, a Coach cannot return to free-plan write access by removing Clients. Restoring write access while the Coach has more than three Clients requires an active Pro subscription.

subscriptions.clientsNote: Clients currently keep using the Client application as usual if their Coach is on the free plan or in read-only mode. We may later limit Client features when the Coach is over the free limit or without Pro. If we do, we will provide prior notice through the Service or by email.
subscriptions.nonPayment: Non-payment or expiry does not immediately delete your data. The Coach account remains available on the terms of the then-applicable plan (including read-only). Retention after account deletion is described in our Privacy Policy.
subscriptions.howYouPay: 6.2 How you pay. Pro is sold only as an in-app purchase through the Apple App Store or Google Play. We do not take card numbers. Apple or Google (as applicable) is the merchant of record for the transaction. Billing may be processed with the assistance of our subscription infrastructure provider (RevenueCat).
subscriptions.appleTitle: 6.3 Apple App Store auto-renewable subscriptions. If you purchase Pro on iOS:

appleItems.item1: Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
appleItems.item2: The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
appleItems.item3: Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, at the price disclosed to you.
appleItems.item4: You can manage the subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Apple ID Account Settings after purchase (Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions).

subscriptions.google: 6.4 Google Play subscriptions. If you purchase Pro on Android, payment is charged to your Google account. The subscription renews automatically until you cancel it in Google Play (Google Play > Payments & subscriptions > Subscriptions). Cancellation and refunds are handled under Google Play's policies.
subscriptions.tied: 6.5 Subscription is tied to your StableFit account. Pro access is attached to your Coach account and stored on our servers. Changing devices, reinstalling the app, or signing in on another device does not require a new purchase while the subscription remains active. You may use Restore Purchases in the app to resynchronize with Apple or Google. Cancellation and billing remain with the store where you originally subscribed.
subscriptions.refunds: 6.6 Refunds. Requests for refunds of in-app purchases must be made to Apple or Google under their respective terms. StableFit cannot process store refunds and is not the merchant of record for those payments.
subscriptions.price: 6.7 Price changes. Apple or Google may notify you of price changes according to their rules. Continued renewal after a change is subject to the applicable store terms and any consent they require.
subscriptions.coachClient: 6.8 Coach–Client payments. Any financial transaction for coaching services is strictly between the Coach and the Client. StableFit is not a party to those transactions and is not responsible for refunds or disputes regarding coaching fees.

items.voluntary: Voluntary upload: Clients may upload photos (front, side, back), body measurements, workouts, nutrition logs, surveys, and messages. Uploading photos is entirely optional.
items.ownership: Ownership: You retain all rights to the content you upload.
items.license: License to us: By uploading content, you grant StableFit a limited license to store and display this content solely to you and your assigned Coach for the purpose of providing the Service.
items.prohibited: Prohibited content: You agree not to upload content that is illegal, pornographic (sexual acts), harassing, or that violates any third-party rights. We reserve the right (but have no obligation) to remove such content.

acceptableUse.title: 8. Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.text: You may not misuse the Service, attempt unauthorized access, interfere with other users, scrape or reverse engineer the Service except as permitted by mandatory law, or use it to send spam or malware. We may suspend or terminate access for material breach, illegal activity, or risk to the Service or other users, with notice where reasonably practicable.
